Welcome to the demo code for the LoadRawDataToMATLAB library! 
The purpose of this library is to read data from the outputs produced 
by the parsing operations on a bag file, and load the data into 
a structured format within a MATLAB variable. Core library functionalities 
include: 
* Loading mapping van data from a file into a rawData structure. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_loadMappingVanDataFromFile
* Plotting one or many rawData structures, saving plots to file. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_plotRawDataPositions
* Saving rawData structures into mat file format. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_saveRawDataMatFiles
* Merging sequences of rawData structures into one rawData structure. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_mergeRawDataStructures

Welcome to the demo code for the LoadRawDataToMATLAB library! 
The purpose of this library is to read data from the outputs produced 
by the parsing operations on a bag file, and load the data into 
a structured format within a MATLAB variable. Core library functionalities 
include: 
* Loading mapping van data from a file into a rawData structure. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_loadMappingVanDataFromFile
* Plotting one or many rawData structures, saving plots to file. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_plotRawDataPositions
* Saving rawData structures into mat file format. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_saveRawDataMatFiles
* Merging sequences of rawData structures into one rawData structure. 
	 See: fcn_LoadRawDataToMATLAB_mergeRawDataStructures
